definitions.explanation: A person of great courage and bravery. In modern usage, strongly associated with the 'hero' character class in Japanese RPGs, anime, and fantasy stories — the chosen protagonist who fights evil.

examples.japanese: {勇者|ゆうしゃ}が{魔王|まおう}を{倒|たお}した。
examples.english: The hero defeated the demon king.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{村|むら}を{救|すく}った{勇者|ゆうしゃ}として{称|たた}えられた。
examples.english: He was praised as the hero who saved the village.

examples.japanese: このゲームでは{勇者|ゆうしゃ}が{仲間|なかま}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{世界|せかい}を{冒険|ぼうけん}する。
examples.english: In this game, the hero goes on an adventure around the world with companions.

notes:
In modern Japanese, {勇者|ゆうしゃ} is overwhelmingly associated with the hero archetype from RPGs and fantasy fiction — especially the Dragon Quest series, which established the "chosen hero who defeats the demon king" trope. The word has a more elevated, literary feel than {英雄|えいゆう} (hero in a historical or real-world sense).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝説|でんせつ}の{勇者|ゆうしゃ} (legendary hero)
- {勇者|ゆうしゃ}パーティー (hero's party)
- {勇者|ゆうしゃ}と{魔王|まおう} (hero and demon king)
